Whether you’re looking to become a certified Tai Chi instructor or simply deepen your personal practice, SOHMA’s Tai Chi program meets you where you are.

Led by Dr. Daniel Hoover — Chiropractor, Licensed Acupuncturist, Master Herbalist, and 5th-Degree Black Belt Tai Chi Master — this program blends traditional Tai Chi, Qi Gong, and modern movement science to support healing, balance, and mindful strength.

Train at your own pace with on-demand videos, guided practice, and ongoing support — whether your goal is personal growth or professional instruction.

🔗 Learn more & begin your journey:
👉 https://tai-chi.sohma.org/

💬 Have questions, email us @assistant@sohma.org
